title: Did SpaceX Just Save the AI Trade?
author: Neil Rozenbaum
description: SpaceX's Q3 2026 earnings report had a significant ripple effect on AI cloud stocks. The company's strong performance and its implications for AI infrastructure demand influenced sentiment across related AI companies including Nebius, CoreWeave, Nvidia, and Iren. The article examines what SpaceX's results mean for the broader AI investment landscape.

title: Vanguard Growth ETF Outperforms Small-Cap Peer Over Five Years
author: Jake Lerch
description: Vanguard Morningstar Growth ETF (VUG) significantly outperformed Vanguard Morningstar Small-Cap Growth ETF (VBK) over five years, delivering 79% total return versus 17%, driven by heavy concentration in mega-cap technology stocks. VUG offers a lower expense ratio (0.03% vs 0.05%) and better performance, while VBK provides broader diversification across 579 holdings with lower volatility for investors seeking to reduce tech exposure.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Delivered exceptional 79% total return over five years (12.3% CAGR), significantly outperformed peer, has lower expense ratio (0.03%), and benefits from heavy concentration in mega-cap tech leaders like Nvidia, Apple, and Microsoft.

title: Don't Get Spooked: Stocks Could Still Soar in Q4
author: Not Specified
description: October's market volatility has been driven by inflation concerns and AI financing debates, particularly CoreWeave's financial struggles. However, the market correction appears contained to tech themes rather than broad-based panic. Entering the historically strongest nine-month stretch of the presidential cycle (Q4 midterm through Q2 pre-election year), markets face headwinds from elevated valuations and high interest rates, though strong earnings growth and AI's transformative potential could support gains.

title: Schneider Electric unveils new prefabricated reference design engineered for modular AI factories
author: Schneider Electric
description: Schneider Electric announced its RapidScale Modular Data Center Reference Design 115, a prefabricated solution for high-density AI infrastructure built on the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform. A joint study with Compass Datacenters found that prefabricated modules reduce onsite installation time by 80%. The design addresses rapid AI infrastructure growth, with global data center capacity expected to increase 170 GW by 2030, with AI workloads accounting for 65% of total demand.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform is featured as the core AI infrastructure component in Schneider Electric's new reference design. This integration validates NVIDIA's technology for large-scale AI deployments and positions it as central to the rapidly growing AI data center market expected to reach 65% of total capacity by 2030.

Company announced innovative modular data center solutions addressing critical market demand for AI infrastructure. The solution demonstrates significant operational improvements (80% reduction in installation time), strong supply chain capabilities (1.35M sq ft manufacturing capacity), and market leadership recognition. The product addresses substantial market growth opportunity with AI workloads expected to reach 65% of data center demand by 2030.

title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Stock Plummeted 13% Last Week. Should You Buy the Dip Before Nov. 3?
author: Anthony Di Pizio
description: AMD stock fell 13% last week amid concerns about AI funding challenges and potential slowdown in data center chip demand. While AMD has closed the performance gap with Nvidia through its MI450 GPUs, the company's stock is priced for perfection at a P/E ratio of 91.8—over three times higher than Nvidia's 27.1. Ahead of AMD's Nov. 3 earnings report, the analyst remains cautious due to elevated valuation and uncertainty in the AI industry, despite AMD's strong growth prospects.
